assumptions.statement: Gate 3 is evidence-constrained concept-design deepening and formal submission production: concept_design_eligible=true; engineering_implementation_verified=false; M_CONCEPT_DESIGN=GO; M_ENGINEERING_IMPLEMENTATION=LOCKED.
assumptions.impact: The M scheme may be completed as a conditional competition concept. No item in this package may be read as construction-ready, site-approved, property-cleared, fire-approved, or engineering-verified.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are repository provisional rough constraints, not official redlines. Their coordinates are retained without silent translation or reshaping.
assumptions.impact: All site, key-area, land-use, building, road, green-space, public-space, phasing and precision-sensitive metrics must be rebound and fully recalculated when official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: The frozen OSM frame is used for real-world contextual analysis and for RF-06/A, IF-01, IF-02 and S2 evidence. It does not define the competition boundary, property, road redline or engineering scope.
assumptions.impact: The OSM-mapped park and RF-06/A do not spatially coincide with the repository provisional formal polygons. The actual A evidence points remain separate analysis helpers and are not shifted into PROV-KEY-002.

assumptions.statement: Doors, column grids, room boundaries, property and lease boundaries, parking capacity and rights, fire access, drop-off, loading, waste, equipment maintenance, utilities, topography and as-built conditions are not verified.
assumptions.impact: Ground-floor plans are interface strategy plans only. Unverified elements use dashed alternatives, variable dimensions and unlock conditions; they cannot be treated as existing facts or approved works.

assumptions.statement: S2 Shuangqing Road has a mapped west-side approach, while a lawful eastward public landing, continuous accessible route, traffic condition, property permission and fire compatibility remain unverified.
assumptions.impact: S2 is a connection test point only. No new through route or side-switching action is claimed unless every landing and ordinary-passage condition is verified.

assumptions.statement: The concept is governed by three non-regression baselines: park net public space must not decrease, ordinary walking/cycling/accessibility capacity must not decline, and existing ecological performance must not regress.
assumptions.impact: These are acceptance rules, not measured current performance. M engineering implementation remains locked until survey/as-built baselines and independent fire, medical, loading, waste and maintenance routes are verified.

assumptions.statement: L is a reversible 0-1 year operational pilot; M is the selected competition concept; D is a long-term possibility only and is not a present commitment.
assumptions.impact: Calendar windows are discussion references rather than approved schedules. Any failed unlock condition returns the affected action to L or removes it.

assumptions.statement: Every AI node must be understandable, rejectable, appealable, human-overridable, closable and removable, with a non-AI equivalent route for essential services.
assumptions.impact: This is a governance floor for all ten scenario cards, not a separate brand and not evidence that any service is already deployed or approved.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, official road redlines, ownership, heritage controls, municipal utilities and engineering constraints are absent from the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: Concept-design coverage can be completed with explicit limits, but statutory planning, engineering feasibility and implementation claims remain unavailable until official attachments and professional review are obtained.
